answer: The theoretical security dreamed up in some academic ivory tower will not keep a main propulsion plant turning when fuel lines foul. Relying on a heavy sable oil filter differential pressure drop forces an agent to prove it consumes scarce computational resources before joining the network. By dawn, any sybil flood exhausts its budget powering cryptographic work matching real fuel throughput costs, though clever attackers might still bypass this if bypass limits fail under extreme load.
